name: price-drop
title: Price Drop
description: A product name rises through a mask, the old price is struck through, the new price counts up to its value in one accent colour and a quiet saving label (like "Hemat 28%") appears under it, on a clean white page.
useWhen: One product has a lower price and the old and new price should be seen side by side.
A shop promo, a menu item or a class fee that dropped.
avoidWhen: Several products with prices in a list: use menu-price-board.
A time-limited sale with a deadline: use flash-sale-burst.
The price is not a number to count up (it only fades in then).
author: Mosio

variables.label: Eyebrow
variables.description: Short line above the product name.

variables.label: New price
variables.description: Price that counts up. Digits are counted with dots as thousands separators; a prefix such as Rp and a suffix such as /pcs are kept.

variables.label: Label
variables.description: Pill stamped under the price, e.g. a saving. Leave empty to hide it.

variables.label: Main colour
variables.description: New price and label outline: the one accent.

variables.label: Transparent
variables.description: Leave the background clear so the price sits over your own scene.
